question: What combination boundary should gate this issue: representative no-auth answer shaping only, a tiered hermetic-plus-curated-live matrix, or an exhaustive credentialed channel × provider matrix?
rationale: The correct boundary depends on maintainer intent for supported combinations, secret ownership, CI cost, rate limits, flake tolerance, and redaction; source inspection cannot safely choose those operational commitments.

options.title: Tiered risk-based matrix
options.body: Cover all answer shapes hermetically and gate a curated set of credentialed Crabbox combinations chosen by auth, plugin-install, and failure-mode families.

options.title: Hermetic coverage only
options.body: Declare the merged answer-shaping tests sufficient and accept that real authentication and plugin-install regressions remain outside this repository’s gate.

options.title: Exhaustive live matrix
options.body: Run every supported channel and provider combination with managed credentials, accepting substantially higher secret-management, runtime, cost, and flake burden.

recommendation.title: Tiered risk-based matrix
recommendation.body: Cover all answer shapes hermetically and gate a curated set of credentialed Crabbox combinations chosen by auth, plugin-install, and failure-mode families.
